text:
Rohit: quick design thread — proposing an adaptive per-layer "shadow" system to mitigate FP8 tail drift in long-contexts without full-model fallback. wanted opinions on boundaries + tradeoffs.
Lena: high level — describe shadowing in 2 lines?
Rohit: run FP8 as usual. for a small set of chosen layers (configurable), also execute a cheap INT8 shadow pass at sampled tokens. compute a lightweight divergence metric; if a layer diverges above threshold, flip that layer to a conservative kernel for the remainder of the request. no immediate full fallback.
Omar: sounds expensive if shadows run every token. what's the sampling plan?
Rohit: sample every N tokens (default N=8) and only shadow the last M layers (default M=4). shadow pass only runs for sampled steps; the shadow kernels are optimized and lower-cost.
Priya: how do we measure divergence cheaply? KL across top-k logits? topk entropy delta?
Rohit: proposal: topk-kl on top-16 logits, compute exponential moving average over last S samples; divide by a per-layer scale to normalize. if ema > layer_threshold -> flip.
Nina: KV cache coherence concerns: flipping a layer's precision mid-request might change cached activations. do we invalidate KV?
Rohit: two options: 1) tag KV entries with precision-version and when a layer flips bump version and invalidate only a small sliding window (e.g., last 32 tokens) to avoid a broad cold start; 2) for flipped layers, recompute a tiny bridge for next token to reconcile states. option 1 is simpler.
Omar: option 1 seems simplest, but cold-window could reintroduce transient issues. need to quantify. Also need to ensure deterministic behavior for reproducibility.
Lena: API surface: add to precision_profile schema a new object: "adaptive_shadow": {
  "layers": [indices],
  "sample_rate": "0.125",
  "threshold": "0.6",
  "escalate_after": "10"
} — but per agents.md we won't include nested JSON here, just naming the fields for implementation. product needs to expose sane defaults.
Priya: product/ops ask: per-tenant budget and kill-switch. shadowing increases compute when active; tenants must opt in or set a quota.
Rohit: agreed. default off for new tenants, opt-in for canary. add a per-endpoint boolean and a "shadow_budget" percent of extra GPU time allowed.
Nina: observability — what metrics do we need?
Rohit: shadow_activation_rate, per_layer_divergence_hist, shadow_effectiveness (deg_score delta pre/post flip), kv_invalidations_count, extra_gpu_ms_when_shadowing, user_visible_regressions. also sample traces with logits for offline eval.
Omar: fallback policy: if soft measures (shadow) don't reduce deg_score within K tokens -> escalate to full-precision fallback for remainder of request. keep escalate_after tunable.
Lena: compatibility with model packaging: model authors should annotate candidate layers ("volatile_layers") during offline calibration. runtime will respect model-provided defaults but ops can override. add tooling to compute candidate list by measuring per-layer sensitivity in calibration.
Priya: UX: add a precision-hint header so clients with long dialogs can request conservative defaults or enable shadows explicitly. docs should recommend this for chat apps with >2k tokens.
Omar: performance risk: switching kernels mid-request may introduce jitter. we should prefer flipping only at sampling boundaries and pre-warm conservative kernels to reduce latency.
Rohit: implementation plan: 1) offline profiler to pick default layers (Rohit) 2) implement shadow executor + cheap topk-kl sampler (Omar) 3) KV tagging + small-window invalidation (Nina) 4) feature-flagged canary for 72h with sampled payloads + offline A/B vs FP16 path (Priya/Ops) 5) if shadow fails, escalate rules + cost controls (Product).
Lena: safety note: any per-layer flip should be logged with deterministic markers so post-hoc debugging and audits are easy. include shadow_id + reasons in traces.
Priya: billing: we need an estimate of extra GPU-ms per shadow activation to present to customers. SRE should add a billing alert if shadow_time > X% of baseline.
SRE-Bot: scheduling: propose canary start Monday 09:00 UTC, shadowing feature-flag enabled for opt-in tenants only, sampling rate 0.125, last-4 layers shadowed. Alerts muted for canary window.
ProductBot: ticket RDW-7082 created: "adaptive per-layer shadowing prototype". Assignment: Rohit/Omar/Nina/Priya.
Rohit: thanks all. follow-ups: Rohit -> offline profiler PR, Omar -> shadow executor spike, Nina -> KV tagging design doc, Priya -> canary plan + tenant opt-in UX. will reconvene after first 48h of canary. :eyes:
